it.txt: Era presidente da Assembleia Legislativa e assumiu o governo de forma interina em 30/04/2026, depois que o TSE cassou o mandato do governador Edilson Damião (que tinha assumido com a renúncia de Antonio Denarium); continua no cargo porque o resultado da eleição suplementar de 21/06/2026 ainda depende de decisão da Justiça
it.txt_en: He was the president of the Legislative Assembly (state parliament). He became acting governor on April 30, 2026, after the TSE (Brazil's Superior Electoral Court) removed Governor Edilson Damião from office. Damião had taken over when Antonio Denarium resigned. Soldado Sampaio is still in office because the result of the special election held on June 21, 2026, still depends on a court decision.

it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 02/04/2026, na Câmara Municipal, depois que Tenorinho Malta renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on April 2, 2026, at the City Council, after Mayor Tenorinho Malta resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.

it.txt: Presidente da Câmara Municipal, tomou posse como prefeito interino em 18/06/2026, depois que a Justiça Eleitoral cassou os mandatos do prefeito Reginaldo Marcomini e da vice Vanja Sabino, eleitos em 2024. Na eleição suplementar de 25/10/2026, foram eleitos Vado (PSD), prefeito, e Pedro Antônio (PSD), vice; eles tomam posse depois da diplomação pela Justiça Eleitoral.
it.txt_en: As president of the City Council, he was sworn in as acting mayor on June 18, 2026, after the Electoral Courts revoked the terms of Mayor Reginaldo Marcomini and Vice Mayor Vanja Sabino, elected in 2024. In the special election held on October 25, 2026, Vado (PSD) was elected mayor and Pedro Antônio (PSD) vice mayor; they take office after being certified by the Electoral Courts.

it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 02/04/2026, em ato no gabinete da prefeitura, depois que Liba Fronza renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor on April 2, 2026, in a ceremony at the mayor's office, after Mayor Liba Fronza resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.
